concerns.text: FR-007 (Synthetic Simulation Fidelity) requires verification that the density metric is computed solely from input text statistics, independent of the agent's output. No task in tasks.md explicitly tests or validates this independence (e.g., a unit test or validation script).

The contract `regression_output.schema.yaml` is listed in the data model, but there is no task that explicitly validates `results/regression_summary.json` against this schema (e.g., a validation script or test).
